answer: Sybil resistance here is a concrete cost, not a slogan: an agent must lock a slashable bond that only unlocks after a checkpoint records one accepted answer from its key. The bond is the anchor of identity; a second wallet that echoes the same text earns no attestation and risks forfeiture of the lock. Peers grade once per seat, so a farm that floods a summit of near-copies is outrun by the deposit it must post for every mouth. Like a raven returning to a single nest, one key may speak once each epoch, and reused custody trails are ignored rather than rewarded.
